camel_example: aliyun polardb CreateLakebaseS3Account --region cn-hangzhou --UserAccAk accname --PfsInstanceId 'pfs-xxx' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --UserAccSk password000
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-lakebase-s3-account --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pfs-instance-id pfs-xxx --user-acc-ak accname --user-acc-sk password000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLakebaseS3Account

parameters.help_en:
The Access Key of the S3 account.

The account name can contain only uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits, and cannot exceed 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
S3 账户 Access Key。

账号名只支持大小写和数字，长度不超过32
parameters.name: user_acc_ak

parameters.help_en:
The Secret Key of the S3 account (@sensitive, encryption in transit).

The key must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits, and must be greater than 18 and no more than 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
S3 账户 Secret Key（@sensitive，传输加密）。

要求大小写和数字必须都包含，长度要求大于18不超过32
parameters.name: user_acc_sk

parameters.help_en: A policy document in JSON format that defines the permissions of the S3 account. If this parameter is not specified, the default policy is used
parameters.help_zh: JSON 格式策略文档，定义 S3 账户权限。不传时使用默认策略
parameters.name: user_acc_policy
